## ResourceIdOf type

The SDK identifier of resource `Key` in `Resources`<!-- -->: the type its `id` value type decodes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ResourceIdOf<
  Resources extends ResourceTable,
  Key extends string,
> = string extends keyof Resources
  ? unknown
  : Key extends keyof Resources
    ? Resources[Key] extends {
        readonly id: ValueType<infer Id>
      }
      ? Id
      : never
    : never
```

**References:** [ResourceTable](./contracts.resourcetable.md)<!-- -->, [ValueType](./contracts.valuetype.md)

## Remarks

`never` when the resource has no identifier, so an identity reference to it, which encoding rejects, does not type-check either. `unknown` for a table whose keys are not known.
